dedupe_keys.name: dinagua water level measurements and water use permits uruguay

description: The National Water Directorate of Uruguay publishes four datasets on the national open data catalogue. Three hold the water level readings recorded by DINAGUA stations in 2017, 2018 and 2019, each as a CSV file of annual readings with a metadata sheet in XLSX. The fourth is the register of permits for the use of water resources in force in 2019 granted by DINAGUA, as CSV with an XLSX metadata sheet. All four are under the Uruguayan open data licence (Licencia de Datos Abiertos, DAG de Uruguay) and are tagged hydrological data, water level and climate change; the catalogue records were last modified in March 2022. Access is free with no registration. Caveats: the level series cover only three years and have not been extended on the catalogue, the permit register is a 2019 snapshot, and the metadata are in Spanish. Coverage is Uruguay. It supports flood exposure analysis along rivers and the planning of water supply and irrigation abstractions; related records are SIAGUAPY of Paraguay and the IMO Iceland hydrometric network.
